tracey-schroeder.text: "I will vote to suspend the Gas Tax, use the state's surplus to cut your taxes, and defend Proposition 13 so families aren't taxed out of their homes. I oppose any new tax increase."
"I oppose 'Defunding the Police.' I will fight for tougher penalties for repeat offenders, hold rogue DAs accountable, stop the refusal to prosecute, and keep dangerous felons behind bars."

Would call for a state audit of homelessness spending, expand mental health and addiction treatment, and "make it easier to place people in care rather than leave them on the street." Homepage: fund Prop 36; prioritize rehabilitation and jobs.

"I will fight for parental rights and school choice, defend parents' voice in their kids' education, and audit education spending." Homepage also lists restoring lower class sizes and trades training.

Platform: protect girls' sports, protect the innocence of children, defend parental participation in schools. Says parents must be informed if their child is at risk of self-harm, and wants "strong, academic, non-sexualized curriculum."
Homepage platform: reduce gas taxes, "reduce regulations & keep refineries in CA," and "STOP the track & tax our miles agenda."
Opposes the state's road-mileage tracking and taxing idea: "STOP the track & tax our miles agenda."

Platform: "Reduce small business taxes." Says small business owners and employees "deserve Sacramento's support, not burdensome regulations and ever-increasing taxation," and calls state over-regulation of business shocking.
Endorsed by the Howard Jarvis Taxpayers Association PAC (listed for Assembly District 46).

notes: Neither candidate answered the League of Women Voters Vote411 questions. Gabriel's campaign site lists endorsements but no issues page. Schroeder: nothing found on immigration, guns, health care, housing growth, or renters.
